binding_metadata_boundary: Allowlisted D1 id/name and secret binding names/types only. Never request secret values, never inspect any value/text/material property. Plaintext variables not requested as key proof.
future_execution_blockers: Executable one-shot workflow/helper must be pinned under separate preparation before execution approval
Exact zone scope absent: full routes proof unavailable
Settings read permission not yet confirmed
Live key readiness cannot be proven from names only
Durable operation lifecycle requires later proof
pagination: Queues/schedules single response completeness required; missing/inconsistent metadata => UNVERIFIED_INCOMPLETE_PAGINATION, no next-page request
permissions: 403/read visibility insufficient => UNVERIFIED_PERMISSION_LIMIT and safe STOP; no broad token request

quota.usage_model_not_quota: Account/worker usage/quota not inferred from settings. Additional officially read-only permission/endpoint proof requires separate preparation.

request_order: content -> settings -> schedules -> queues; no fallback or extra GET

routes.required_before_visibility_PASS: Exact zone evidence and separately bounded GET /zones/{exact_zone_id}/workers/routes plan; no guessed zone or account routes endpoint

secret_key_readiness: Name presence only; validity/role/distinctness/value unavailable => UNVERIFIED_PERMISSION_LIMIT; no secret endpoint
source_boundary: In-memory SHA256 only; never print/persist raw source. Raw response MIME/multipart must not be presumed equal to standalone bundle. If exact comparable source representation cannot be proven => UNVERIFIED_SOURCE_REPRESENTATION.

target_d1.name: plm-serverless-sandbox-state
target_d1.verification: settings binding identity only; no D1 endpoint

workers_dev_preview_routes: If settings do not prove exposure inactive => BLOCKED_REMOTE_VISIBILITY; do not invoke Worker fetch to test
